page_title: JUV 0-2 FIO | Juventus v Fiorentina 17/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' 0 - 1 Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+7' A quickly taken corner by Fiorentina.
90+6' Dodo (Fiorentina) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
90+6' Davide Massa couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Dodo (Fiorentina) and blew his whistle.
90+1' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
90+1' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Luciano Spalletti has decided to make a change. Fabio Miretti (Juventus) replaces Kenan Yildiz.

90' That didn't go as planned! Jeremie Boga (Juventus) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the right side of the goal was too weak to get past David de Gea, who easily kept it out.

88' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. David de Gea pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
88' Roberto Piccoli (Fiorentina) has a goal ruled out for offside!
86' Jeremie Boga dinks a lofted pass into the path of Edon Zhegrova (Juventus) inside the box, but his drive sails a whisker past the right post.
85' Jack Harrison (Fiorentina) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
83' 0 - 2 Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) produces a moment of pure magic and scores a spectacular goal by striking the ball into the top left corner of the net!
81' The referee signals a substitution. Federico Gatti (Juventus) is brought on as a substitute for Lloyd Kelly.
80' Davide Massa blows his whistle. Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) commits a foul after dangerous play.
79' Jeremie Boga (Juventus) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.
78' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Fiorentina is cautioned for aggressive play.
76' Roberto Piccoli (Fiorentina) is first to react to a loose pass inside the box, but slices his shot just wide of the right post.
74' Substitution. Robin Gosens makes way for Luis Balbo (Fiorentina).
73' The goal by Juventus is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
72' Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) is shown a red card by the referee after criticising his decision!
71' The Juventus players halt their celebrations as referee Davide Massa makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
70' Goal! Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) fires the rebound inside the left post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:1.
69' The substitution has been made. Khephren Thuram (Juventus) has replaced Andrea Cambiaso.
69' Here is a change. Francisco Conceicao is going off and Luciano Spalletti gives the last tactical orders to Edon Zhegrova (Juventus).
67' David de Gea makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the right-hand post by Bremer (Juventus) after a cross from the side.
66' The game is interrupted. Cher Ndour (Fiorentina) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
64' Substitution. Nicolo Fagioli leaves the pitch and is replaced by Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina).
64' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Luca Ranieri trots off the pitch and is replaced by Pietro Comuzzo (Fiorentina).
64' Paolo Vanoli decides to make a substitution. Marco Brescianini will be replaced by Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina).
62' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Jeremie Boga (Juventus) takes it short.
62' Jeremie Boga (Juventus) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away. Juventus earn a corner.
61' The ball is in the net but it’s immediately ruled out by referee Davide Massa due to a foul, much to the disappointment of the Weston McKennie (Juventus) and his team.
59' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) watches the corner all the way, but places his header a whisker wide of the left post from close range.
59' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) steps up to send the ball in.

59' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Juventus.
59' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

59' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his low drive towards the right post, but the keeper dives low to keep the ball out. The ball goes behind for a corner. Juventus will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
58' Jack Harrison (Fiorentina) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.
58' Weston McKennie (Juventus) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a low drive to the middle, but David de Gea makes a save.
57' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
56' A short pass finds Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar.
55' Jeremie Boga (Juventus) picks up the rebound after chaos in the box and directs a sweet strike towards the underside of the crossbar. The goalkeeper, however, denies him with a stunning save.
53' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.

52' Manor Solomon (Fiorentina) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the roof of the net, but Michele Di Gregorio thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
51' Davide Massa blows his whistle after Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
50' Handball! A player from Fiorentina handled the ball.
49' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) comes close to scoring! He meets a lovely lofted pass from Francisco Conceicao, but sends his close-range header way wide of the left post.
47' Jeremie Boga (Juventus) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
47' Jeremie Boga (Juventus) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players. It will be a corner kick for Juventus.
46' Luciano Spalletti makes a half-time substitution. Jeremie Boga (Juventus) comes on in place of Teun Koopmeiners.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Dodo (Fiorentina) was too forceful with his tackle and Davide Massa interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
45+1' Manor Solomon (Fiorentina) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

45+1' What a wasted opportunity by Jack Harrison (Fiorentina)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the bottom left corner, but Michele Di Gregorio makes an astonishing save to thwart him. Fiorentina get a corner.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45' Bremer (Juventus) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
43' Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Juventus.
42' Manor Solomon (Fiorentina) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
41' A long pass finds Kenan Yildiz (Juventus), and he decides to test the keeper from long range. The shot flies towards the right side of the goal, but David de Gea reacts well to make a good save.
39' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) is penalised for a foul. Davide Massa had a clear view and blows his whistle.
39' Pierre Kalulu (Juventus) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
39' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
36' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) gets to the ball on the edge of the box after the corner and unleashes a shot which flies well wide of the right post.
36' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

35' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention. The ball is out of play. Juventus win a corner kick.
34' 0 - 1 Goal! Cher Ndour (Fiorentina) takes a short pass from Manor Solomon in his stride in the box, jinks inside his man and unleashes an unstoppable shot into the bottom right corner. 0:1.
32' Problems for Paolo Vanoli as Fabiano Parisi is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Jack Harrison (Fiorentina) replaces him.
29' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
29' Lloyd Kelly (Juventus) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Davide Massa blows his whistle for a foul.
28' Weston McKennie (Juventus) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Davide Massa no option but to blow his whistle.
24' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
24' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
23' Half-chance! Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) plays a pass into the box, but David de Gea reacts well to snuff out the attack.
22' Marin Pongracic (Fiorentina) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
21' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) tackles a bit over-zealously and Davide Massa blows for a foul.
21' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) sends in the corner, but the keeper steps in and makes a save.

20' Corner kick. Juventus will have an opportunity. Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
20' A tremendous drive by Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) from inside the box towards the middle of the goal looks like it's in, but David de Gea makes a brilliant save.
19' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Davide Massa blows for a foul.
19' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick.
18' Roberto Piccoli (Fiorentina) takes a neat pass, dummies a defender and slams the ball well wide of the left post from the edge of the box.
17' Dodo (Fiorentina) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
17' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Kenan Yildiz (Juventus), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
16' Juventus concede a free kick following a bad challenge.
15' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) slams the ball towards the middle of the goal, but it fails to surprise David de Gea and he's equal to it.
15' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
14' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
13' Roberto Piccoli (Fiorentina) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
12' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
10' Dodo (Fiorentina) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
9' Weston McKennie (Juventus) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Davide Massa blows his whistle for a foul.
8' Bremer (Juventus) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
6' Dodo (Fiorentina) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
3' Some patient build-up play from Juventus as they look to unlock the defence.
